title: Autodiff Tape Wars
tagline: Compare reverse-mode, checkpointed reverse-mode, forward-mode, and mixed-mode AD strategies by runtime growth.

curves.label: Naive Reverse-Mode
curves.code: tape=[]; forward(x){ for each op: tape.push(op); y=eval(ops); } backward(y){ for(i=tape.length-1;i>=0;i--) propagate_grad(tape[i]); }
curves.name: Naive Reverse-Mode

curves.label: Checkpointed Reverse-Mode
curves.code: schedule = buildCheckpoints(n, k); forward_store(x){ run until ckpt; store state; recompute between ckpts during backprop; } backward(){ for segments reversed: recompute segment forward, then backprop grads; }
curves.name: Checkpointed Reverse-Mode

curves.label: Forward-Mode Dual Numbers
curves.code: dual = makeDual(x, v); for each op: dual = lift(op, dual); return dual.value, dual.tangent;
curves.name: Forward-Mode Dual Numbers

curves.label: Mixed-Mode (Chunked Reverse)
curves.code: split inputs into blocks B; for each block: run reverse-mode w.r.t. block while forward-propagating others; merge partials.
curves.name: Mixed-Mode (Chunked Reverse)

curves.label: Symbolic Differentiation
curves.code: expr = parse(program); deriv = differentiate(expr); simplify(deriv); evaluate(deriv, x);
curves.name: Symbolic Differentiation
